scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: One audited presentation-only runtime class, GameButtonMotionPresenter, raises the project class set from 225 to 226. It owns only the visual paper face inside a stable BaseButton hit box and does not own navigation, canonical gameplay state, RNG, persistence, or replay data. This recalibration changes only the declared project class-set count; the existing ObjectDB, Resource, and RID ceilings remain unchanged and continue to be enforced by the safe GUT runner.
